title: GPT-5.6 构建者指南：助力初创企业打造高效AI代理
summary: 本文是OpenAI发布的面向开发者的指南，重点介绍GPT-5.6模型及其在构建AI代理中的应用。文章指出，初创企业可利用GPT-5.6实现更快速、更经济高效的AI代理开发，关键在于智能的模型选择策略和新增的Responses API功能。指南强调，通过根据任务复杂度动态选择不同规模的模型，企业可以显著降低推理成本并提升响应速度。同时，Responses API提供了更灵活的交互接口，支持多步骤任务编排、工具调用和状态管理，简化了代理的构建流程。文中可能包含实际案例，展示初创公司如何利用这些能力优化客户支持、自动化工作流等场景。整体上，该指南为开发者提供了实用的技术路径，帮助他们在资源有限的情况下最大化AI代理的性能与成本效益。
summary_en: This is a builder's guide from OpenAI focusing on GPT-5.6 for developing AI agents. It highlights how startups can build faster and more cost-efficient AI agents through smarter model selection and new Responses API capabilities. The guide emphasizes dynamic model choice based on task complexity to reduce costs and improve speed, while the Responses API enables flexible multi-step orchestration, tool calling, and state management. It likely includes real-world examples of startups optimizing customer support and workflow automation. Overall, it offers practical technical strategies for maximizing performance and cost-effectiveness with limited resources.
